title: ICP Qualifier Output
description: Terminal output of the icp-qualifier Brick. Returns a completed business decision as Success regardless of outcome. The allOf block below enforces three cross-field invariants: next_action=qualified requires icp_match=true + a numeric score strictly greater than 0.5 and up to 1; next_action=not_qualified requires icp_match=false + a numeric score from 0 up to and including 0.5; next_action=needs_enrichment requires icp_match=null + score=null. The 0.5 boundary expresses a strict-majority contract (>0.5 means majority of recognized dimensions match); it is not an implementation-specific arithmetic value and remains correct under future weighted or N-dimension scoring.

company_name.description: Echo of input.company_name from the upstream catalog lookup. Not a verified real-company fact. Null when the upstream profile was not found.

industry.description: Echo of input.industry from the upstream catalog. Null when the upstream profile was not found.

icp_match.description: Qualification decision: true=matches target ICP, false=does not match, null=insufficient evidence to decide. See the allOf block below for the invariant tying icp_match to next_action.

score.description: Documented 0-1 rule-based ICP compatibility score. Null when the decision is needs_enrichment (insufficient evidence). This is NOT a statistical confidence estimate; it is a rule-based measure of how well the resolved profile satisfies the recognized target-ICP dimensions.

reasons.description: Human-readable explanations in a stable deterministic order (industry, segment, audience, then any applicable qualification-limitation reason). Always at least one entry; capped at five.

next_action.description: Business-decision verdict. 'qualified' and 'not_qualified' are completed decisions over a known profile with sufficiently interpretable ICP. 'needs_enrichment' means either the company profile is not in the catalog or the target ICP does not provide recognized descriptors spanning all three dimensions.
